Class ImuSample

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.imu.ImuSample
public final class ImuSample extends Object
Caller-owned inertial sensor data. Angles and angular rates use milli-degrees to retain useful resolution without floating-point state; create one instance and reuse it for every read.
